name: ad-blank-password-win
description: Practice-box helper (Active Directory, DC-only): creates or updates a domain user that requires NO password (PasswordNotRequired account control flag) -- the account then accepts blank logons outright. This is the domain-side analog of pinecrest's blank-password local account (a normal enabled domain account cannot have an empty password, but a PasswordNotRequired one can). Vars: USERNAME (required); FULLNAME (optional); DESCRIPTION (optional); NEVER_EXPIRES (optional, default 0). Pairs with a powershell_json check sweeping ENABLED accounts whose PasswordNotRequired flag is set. Must run on a DC. Idempotent.
